title: Cuproptosis: mechanisms and nanotherapeutic strategies in cancer and beyond
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00083A, Review Article
Lijie Mao, Ji Lu, Xinyu Wen, Zhiyi Song, Cai Sun, Yuanru Zhao, Fang Huang, Si Chen, Dongyang Jiang, Wenliang Che, Cheng Zhong, Chen Yu, Ke Li, Xiangyu Lu, Jianlin Shi
This review explores the mechanisms and rational designs of nanomaterial-mediated cuproptosis and its innovative nanotherapeutic strategies in cancer and other potential applications, highlighting the targeted therapies and clinical potential.
